notes: One table of 16, 30 rounds, champion on points - no split and no championship play-off in 2026-27. Bottom three are relegated directly to Ligue Professionnelle 2, which is not in our rows, so closed_down is flagged true per the 'no league below in our list' rule; those three clubs leave the modelled pyramid. Top two go to the CAF Champions League, third to the Confederation Cup. Older seasons used 14 clubs and, in some years, a group/play-off phase, so a stored format taken from another season may be stale.
